DLG-SC-LOC-023-11-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-11-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お食事はお済みでしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-023-11-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-11-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: まだ食べていますが、空のトレーだけ返却口へ置いてしまいました。残っている丼を運ぶ時に必要なので、トレーをもう一枚使ってもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-11-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 食事途中に返したトレーの代わりを依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-11-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm still eating, but I already put the empty tray at the return point. I'll need one to carry the bowl I still have. May I use another tray?
DLG-SC-LOC-023-11-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a replacement for the tray you returned before finishing your meal. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-11-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-11-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 清潔なトレーを一枚お渡しします。返却口の物は戻さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-11-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll give you a clean tray. Please don't take back anything from the return point.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-11-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-11-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。返した物を取り戻さず、新しい方を使います。丼はまだ半分残っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-11-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 返却済みを戻さず清潔なトレーを使うと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-11-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. I won't retrieve the returned tray; I'll use the new one. The bowl is still half full.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-11-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will use a clean tray without taking back the one already returned. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-11-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-11-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 食べ終わるまでは、お席に置いて構いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-11-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can keep it at your seat until you finish eating.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-11-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-11-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では席へ戻ります。熱い丼を手で持って移そうとしていましたが、トレーを平らに置いてから載せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-11-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 熱い丼を平らなトレーに載せると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-11-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll go back to my seat. I was about to carry the hot bowl in my hands, but I'll put the tray down flat before placing the bowl on it.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-11-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will put the hot bowl on a tray that is lying flat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-11-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-11-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 無理に運ばず、必要ならお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-11-001-SHARED-07.translation: Don't try to carry more than you can manage. Please ask if you need help.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-11-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-11-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。今は自分で載せられます。飲み物は別の手で同時に運ばず、一度席に置いてからにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-11-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 飲み物と丼を同時に運ばないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-11-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I can place it on the tray myself now. I won't carry my drink at the same time in my other hand. I'll do that after first setting this at my seat.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-11-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not carry the drink and bowl at the same time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-11-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-11-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お食事が終わりましたら、食器も一緒に返却してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-11-001-SHARED-09.translation: When you finish your meal, please return the dishes together with it.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-11-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-11-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 食べ終えたら、丼をこのトレーに載せて返します。さっき置いたトレーの分まで二枚探す必要はないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-11-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 終了後丼と新しい一枚を返すと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-11-001-SHARED-10.translation: After eating, I'll put the bowl on this tray and return them. So I don't need to look for two trays, including the one I returned earlier?
DLG-SC-LOC-023-11-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will return the bowl and the one new tray after finishing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-11-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-11-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、この一枚をお返しください。それでは、ごゆっくりお召し上がりください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-11-001-SHARED-11.translation: That's right, please return this one tray. Please take your time enjoying your meal.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-12-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-12-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お席の準備で、ご不明な点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-12-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything unclear about setting up your table?

DLG-SC-LOC-023-12-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-12-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この空の器は灰皿ですか。友人がたばこを置こうとしていますが、使う前に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-12-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 空容器が灰皿か使用前に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-12-001-SHARED-02.translation: Is this empty dish an ashtray? My friend is about to put a cigarette in it, but I'd like to check before using it.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-12-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the empty container is an ashtray before using it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-12-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-12-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それは料理で出た骨などを入れる器です。灰皿ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-12-001-SHARED-03.translation: That dish is for bones and other scraps from the food. It isn't an ashtray.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-12-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-12-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうなのですね。まだ何も入れていません。友人には、たばこを置かないよう今伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-12-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未使用と伝え友人へたばこを置かないよう話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-12-001-SHARED-04.translation: I see. We haven't put anything in it yet. I'll tell my friend now not to put a cigarette in it.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-12-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say it has not been used and tell your friend not to put a cigarette in it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-12-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-12-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。喫煙場所の利用については、店の案内をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-12-001-SHARED-05.translation: Thank you. Please check the restaurant's guidance about using the smoking area.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-12-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-12-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ここで吸えると形だけで判断しません。まず食事を始めたいので、友人にはたばこをしまってもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-12-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 形で喫煙可否を判断せず収納してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-12-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't assume smoking is allowed here just from its shape. We'd like to start eating first, so I'll have my friend put the cigarette away.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-12-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not judge whether smoking is allowed from its shape; have your friend put the cigarette away. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-12-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-12-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その器は、皆様でお使いいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-12-001-SHARED-07.translation: Everyone at the table may use that dish.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-12-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-12-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 手羽先の骨を入れるために真ん中へ置きます。飲み物の空のグラスまでそこに重ねる必要はないですよね。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-12-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 中央へ骨器を置きグラスも入れる必要か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-12-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll put it in the middle for chicken-wing bones. We don't need to stack empty drinking glasses in it too, do we?
DLG-SC-LOC-023-12-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Place the bone dish in the middle and ask whether glasses also need to go in it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-12-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-12-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、グラスはそのまま置いてください。骨の器がいっぱいになったら交換します。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-12-001-SHARED-09.translation: That's right. Please leave the glasses where they are. We'll replace the bone dish when it is full.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-12-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-12-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。骨だけ入れて、いっぱいになったら声をかけます。灰皿と間違える前に確認できて助かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-12-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 骨だけ入れ満杯時交換を頼むと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-12-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. We'll put only bones in it and call you when it's full. I'm glad we checked before mistaking it for an ashtray.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-12-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will put only bones in it and ask for replacement when full. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-12-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-12-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞお料理をお楽しみください。それでは、ごゆっくりお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-12-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please enjoy the food and take your time.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-13-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-13-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: カレーをお持ちしました。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-13-001-SHARED-01.translation: Here's your curry. Can I help with anything?

DLG-SC-LOC-023-13-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-13-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 注文した野菜が見えないのですが、まだ載せ忘れているのでしょうか。混ぜる前に見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-13-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 隠れた注文野菜を混ぜる前に確認依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-13-001-SHARED-02.translation: I can't see the vegetables I ordered. Have they not been added yet? Could you look before I mix it?
DLG-SC-LOC-023-13-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to check the ordered vegetables that are hidden, before mixing the curry. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-13-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-13-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらのルーの下に、野菜が入っています。スプーンで少しよけてご覧になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-13-001-SHARED-03.translation: The vegetables are under the curry sauce here. Would you like to move a little aside with your spoon to see?

DLG-SC-LOC-023-13-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-13-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 見えました。上に全部載ると思っていました。追加を頼むつもりでしたが、入っているなら不要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-13-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 具を見つけ追加不要と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-13-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can see them now. I thought they would all be on top. I was going to order extra, but if they're in there, I don't need any.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-13-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you found the ingredients and do not need any extra. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-13-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-13-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらでよろしければ、そのままお召し上がりください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-13-001-SHARED-05.translation: If this is all right, please enjoy it as it is.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-13-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-13-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。これは注文した野菜カレーです。ルーをこぼさないよう、皿の中で少しずつご飯と合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-13-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 注文品を確認し皿内で少しずつ合わせると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-13-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. This is the vegetable curry I ordered. I'll combine a little sauce and rice at a time within the plate so I don't spill it.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-13-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm it is what you ordered and say you will combine it gradually within the plate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-13-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-13-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかにご注文との違いはございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-13-001-SHARED-07.translation: Is anything else different from your order?

DLG-SC-LOC-023-13-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-13-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 辛さは注文どおりです。具が見えなかったことだけ確認したかったので、作り直しはお願いしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-13-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 辛さに問題なく作直不要と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-13-001-SHARED-08.translation: The spiciness is as ordered. I only wanted to check because I couldn't see the ingredients, so I'm not asking for it to be remade.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-13-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the spiciness is fine and it does not need to be remade. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-13-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-13-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。ご不明な点があれば、お声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-13-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Please let us know if anything is unclear.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-13-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-13-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。見える位置だけで具の有無を決めず、先に聞けてよかったです。このままいただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-13-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 見え方だけで判断せず確認できたと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-13-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'm glad I asked first rather than deciding the ingredients were missing just from what was visible. I'll eat it as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-13-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you could check rather than judge only by appearances. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-13-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-13-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞお召し上がりください。それでは、ごゆっくり。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-13-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please enjoy your meal and take your time.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-14-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-14-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 組み立ては進んでいますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-023-14-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-14-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 屋根まで付けましたが、机に部品が二つ残っています。説明の一ページを飛ばしたかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-14-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 部品二つが残り工程飛ばしを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-14-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've attached the roof, but two parts are left on the table. I may have skipped a page of the instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-14-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about possibly skipping a step because two parts remain. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-14-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-14-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 説明書の三番を見てみましょう。入口の柱を付ける工程です。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-14-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's look at step three in the instructions. It's the step for attaching the entrance posts.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-14-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-14-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そこだけ読んでいませんでした。余ったのは柱なのですね。屋根を無理に引っ張らず、外し方を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-14-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 柱工程を見つけ屋根の外し方を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-14-001-SHARED-04.translation: That's the part I didn't read. So the leftover pieces are posts. Please show me how to remove the roof, rather than pulling it off by force.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-14-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Find the post-attachment step and ask how to remove the roof. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-14-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-14-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず模型を机に置いてください。私が外し方をお見せします。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-14-001-SHARED-05.translation: First put the model on the table. I'll show you how to remove it.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-14-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-14-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 机に置きました。横から支えて外すのですね。実際に私が外す前に、もう一度手の位置を見せてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-14-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 机上で手の位置を再実演してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-14-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've put it on the table. So you support it from the side when removing it. Could you show me the hand positions once more before I actually remove it myself?
DLG-SC-LOC-023-14-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for another demonstration of the hand positions with the model on the table. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-14-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-14-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ここを支えます。次に柱を二つ付けて、屋根を戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-14-001-SHARED-07.translation: Support it here. Next attach the two posts and put the roof back.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-14-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-14-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 柱を付けられました。見本と比べて、左右とも入口の外側になっています。これで屋根を戻していいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-14-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 柱の左右位置を確認し屋根戻し可否を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-14-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've attached the posts. Compared with the example, both are on the outside of the entrance. May I put the roof back now?
DLG-SC-LOC-023-14-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the left and right positions of the posts and ask if you may put the roof back. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-14-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-14-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。押し込む前に、載せる位置をそろえてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-14-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Line up the position before pressing it into place.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-14-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-14-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 位置を合わせて戻せました。部品がなくなっただけで完成とせず、最後に説明書の工程も見直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-14-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 完成後も説明工程を見直すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-14-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've lined it up and put it back. I won't call it finished just because there are no parts left; I'll review the instruction steps one last time too.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-14-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will review the instruction steps even after assembly. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-14-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-14-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: よくできましたね。それでは、完成した模型をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-14-001-SHARED-11.translation: Well done. Enjoy your completed model.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-15-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-15-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 鳥の展示をご覧になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-15-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to see the bird exhibit?

DLG-SC-LOC-023-15-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-15-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この表示には「夜行性」とあります。今は昼なので、一日中寝ていて何も見られないという意味でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-15-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 夜行性が昼中睡眠で観察不能を意味するか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-15-001-SHARED-02.translation: This sign says 'nocturnal.' Since it's daytime now, does that mean it sleeps all day and there is nothing to observe?
DLG-SC-LOC-023-15-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether nocturnal means sleeping all day and being impossible to observe. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-15-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-15-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 主に夜に活動する性質を表します。いつも昼に眠っていると決める表示ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-15-001-SHARED-03.translation: It describes a tendency to be active mainly at night. The sign does not mean it always sleeps during the day.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-15-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-15-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昼に必ず寝る、という意味ではないのですね。今、目を開けて止まっている姿も観察してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-15-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 必ず昼寝ではないと理解し静止姿の観察を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-15-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it doesn't necessarily sleep during the day. May we also observe it sitting still with its eyes open now?
DLG-SC-LOC-023-15-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you understand it does not always sleep during the day and check whether observing it still is all right. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-15-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-15-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。静かにご覧ください。起こすためにガラスをたたくことはしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-15-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Please watch quietly. Don't tap the glass to wake it up.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-15-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-15-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: たたかずに見ます。子どもが手を振って呼ぼうとしているので、動かすために呼び続けないよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-15-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ガラスをたたかず子にも呼び続けないよう伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-15-001-SHARED-06.translation: We'll watch without tapping. My child is waving and trying to call it, so I'll tell them not to keep calling to make it move.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-15-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will not tap the glass and will tell your child not to keep calling either. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-15-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-15-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 動きの少ない時も、羽や足の形をご覧になれますよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-15-001-SHARED-07.translation: Even when it isn't moving much, you can look at the shapes of its wings and feet.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-15-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-15-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 枝をつかむ足が見えます。歩いていなくても足の形を見られるので、子どもにはそこを指して説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-15-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 静止時にも枝をつかむ足を子へ説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-15-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can see its feet gripping the branch. We can see their shape even when it isn't walking, so I'll point that out to my child.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-15-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the feet gripping the branch to your child even when the bird is still. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-15-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-15-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 通行の妨げにならないようにご覧くださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-15-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please watch without blocking the walkway.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-15-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-15-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 少し横へ寄ります。今日は「夜行性」の意味と足の形を見たと、子どもの観察カードに一緒に書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-15-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通路を空け語の意味と足形を観察カードへ書く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-15-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll move a little to the side. Together we'll write on my child's observation card that today we learned what 'nocturnal' means and looked at the shape of its feet.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-15-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the walkway clear and write the word's meaning and the feet's shape on the observation card. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-15-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-15-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ静かに観察をお楽しみください。それでは、よい一日を。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-15-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please enjoy observing quietly. Have a good day.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-16-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-16-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 池の景色をご覧になっていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-16-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're enjoying the view of the pond, aren't you?

DLG-SC-LOC-023-16-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-16-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族が写真を見て、木が逆さまに植えてあると言いました。水面に映った木だと日本語で説明したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-16-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 逆さまの木に見える反射を日本語で説明したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-16-001-SHARED-02.translation: My family saw the photo and said the trees were planted upside down. I'd like to explain in Japanese that they are trees reflected on the water.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-16-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to explain in Japanese the reflection that looks like upside-down trees. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-16-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-16-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 「木が水面に映っています」と言えますよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-16-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can say, 'The trees are reflected on the water's surface.'

DLG-SC-LOC-023-16-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-16-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 木が水面に映っています、ですね。写真の上の木が本物で、下が映った姿だと続けて説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-16-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本物と水面の像を上下で説明すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-16-001-SHARED-04.translation: 'The trees are reflected on the water's surface,' right? I'll go on to explain that the trees at the top of the photo are real, and below are their reflections.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-16-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will explain the real trees and their water reflections as above and below. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-16-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-16-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 風が吹くと、映った形は揺れて見えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-16-001-SHARED-05.translation: When the wind blows, the reflected shapes appear to sway.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-16-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-16-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今、下の形だけ揺れました。木が倒れているのではなく、水面が動いて映り方が変わるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-16-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 水面の揺れで像が変わると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-16-001-SHARED-06.translation: Just now, only the shapes below moved. So the trees aren't falling over; the water moves and changes how the reflections look.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-16-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that the reflections change because the water moves. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-16-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-16-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのとおりです。岸から離れて、安全な位置でご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-16-001-SHARED-07.translation: That's right. Stay back from the bank and look from a safe position.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-16-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-16-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 通路の内側で、風が弱くなるのを待ちます。きれいな反射を撮るために水へ物を投げたりはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-16-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通路内で風を待ち物を投げないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-16-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll stay on the inner side of the path and wait for the wind to ease. I won't throw anything into the water to get a pretty reflection photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-16-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will wait for the wind from inside the path and will not throw anything. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-16-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-16-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 落ち着くと、また形が見えやすくなりますよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-16-001-SHARED-09.translation: When it settles, the shapes will become easier to see again.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-16-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-16-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今は形がはっきりしました。写真に「上は木、下は水面に映った姿」と書き添えて、家族へ送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-16-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 上下の説明を写真に添えて送ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-16-001-SHARED-10.translation: The shapes are clear now. I'll add 'Trees above, their reflections on the water below' to the photo and send it to my family.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-16-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will add an explanation of above and below to the photo and send it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-16-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-16-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ景色をお持ち帰りください。それでは、ごゆっくり。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-16-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take the scenery home with you in your photo. Take your time.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-17-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-17-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 鍵の番号についてお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-17-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble with the key number?

DLG-SC-LOC-023-17-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-17-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。下駄箱は二十八番でしたが、更衣室で二十八番を探しても鍵が合いません。別の鍵を受け取ったのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-17-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 下駄箱番号のロッカーで鍵が合わないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-17-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My shoe locker was number twenty-eight, but the key doesn't fit number twenty-eight in the changing room. Was I given the wrong key?
DLG-SC-LOC-023-17-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the key not fitting the changing-room locker with your shoe-locker number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-17-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-17-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 下駄箱と更衣室のロッカーは別です。今お持ちの更衣室の鍵には何番とありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-17-001-SHARED-03.translation: The shoe lockers and changing-room lockers are separate. What number is on the changing-room key you have now?

DLG-SC-LOC-023-17-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-17-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 六十三とあります。下駄箱と同じ番号になると思って、鍵の数字を見ていませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-17-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 更衣室鍵六十三を読み思込を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-17-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says sixty-three. I thought it would be the same number as the shoe locker, so I hadn't looked at the number on the key.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-17-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Read sixty-three on the changing-room key and explain your assumption. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-17-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-17-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 更衣室では六十三番をご利用ください。下駄箱の鍵は、受付でお預かりしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-17-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please use number sixty-three in the changing room. We're holding your shoe-locker key at reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-17-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-17-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、合わない二十八番に差し込むのはやめます。六十三番を探し、番号を見てから開けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-17-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 誤った二十八へ差込をやめ六十三を探す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-17-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll stop trying to insert it in number twenty-eight, where it doesn't fit. I'll find number sixty-three and check the number before opening it.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-17-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Stop trying the wrong number twenty-eight and look for sixty-three. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-17-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-17-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お帰りの際には、更衣室の鍵をこちらへお返しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-17-001-SHARED-07.translation: When you leave, please return the changing-room key here.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-17-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-17-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: その時に下駄箱の鍵を返してもらうのですね。番号二十八は靴、六十三は更衣室と分けて覚えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-17-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 靴と更衣室番号と帰りの鍵交換を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-17-001-SHARED-08.translation: And you'll give me back the shoe-locker key then, right? I'll remember them separately: twenty-eight for shoes and sixty-three for the changing room.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-17-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the shoe and changing-room numbers and the key exchange when leaving. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-17-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-17-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。鍵をなくさないようお気をつけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-17-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please take care not to lose the key.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-17-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-17-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 更衣室の鍵は手首に付けます。帰る時は六十三を返して、受け取った下駄箱の鍵の番号も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-17-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 手首保管し返却後の下駄箱鍵番号も確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-17-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll wear the changing-room key on my wrist. When I leave, I'll return sixty-three and also check the number of the shoe-locker key I receive.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-17-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will keep it on your wrist and check the shoe-locker key number after returning it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-17-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-17-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それで大丈夫です。それでは、ごゆっくりお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-17-001-SHARED-11.translation: That will be fine. Please enjoy your time here.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-18-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-18-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 洗面台について、お困りでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-18-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble with the washbasin?

DLG-SC-LOC-023-18-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-18-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 横にある丸い鏡を見たら、顔が大きく見えました。鏡が変形していると思ったのですが、そういう鏡なのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-18-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 丸鏡で顔が大きいのは変形か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-18-001-SHARED-02.translation: When I looked in the round mirror at the side, my face looked big. I thought the mirror was warped. Is it meant to be like that?
DLG-SC-LOC-023-18-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether your face looks large in the round mirror because it is warped. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-18-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-18-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その丸い鏡は、近くを見るための拡大鏡です。正面の大きい鏡とは見え方が違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-18-001-SHARED-03.translation: That round mirror is a magnifying mirror for looking at things up close. It shows things differently from the large mirror in front.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-18-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-18-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 壊れたと決めつけなくてよかったです。離れて顔全体を見るなら、正面の大きい方を使えばいいのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-18-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 故障でなく拡大と理解し全体は正面鏡と確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-18-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'm glad I didn't assume it was broken. So to see my whole face from a distance, I should use the large one in front?
DLG-SC-LOC-023-18-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Understand that it magnifies rather than being faulty, and confirm you should use the front mirror for the whole view. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-18-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-18-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。丸い鏡は、近い位置で細かい部分を見る時にお使いいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-18-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. You can use the round mirror to look at small details up close.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-18-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-18-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 顔を近づけると分かりやすくなりました。鏡を壁から外して手に持とうとはせず、この位置で使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-18-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 近距離で使い壁から取り外さないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-18-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's clearer when I bring my face closer. I won't try to remove the mirror from the wall and hold it; I'll use it where it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-18-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will use it up close without removing it from the wall. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-18-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-18-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 角度を変える時は、無理に引っ張らないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-18-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please don't pull it forcefully when changing the angle.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-18-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-18-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今の角度で見えます。家族には、正面は普通の鏡、横は拡大鏡と伝えます。顔の大きさが変わったとは説明しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-18-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族へ普通鏡と拡大鏡の違いを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-18-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can see at the current angle. I'll tell my family that the front one is a regular mirror and the side one is a magnifying mirror. I won't explain it as my face changing size.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-18-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the difference between the regular and magnifying mirrors to your family. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-18-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-18-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご利用中に動きが悪いなどの不具合があれば、お知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-18-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you notice a problem during use, such as it not moving smoothly, please let us know.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-18-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-18-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。今回は不具合の報告ではなく、見え方の確認で済みました。身支度が終わったら、鏡に物を掛けずにそのままにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-18-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今回不具合でなく見え方確認と述べ物を掛けない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-18-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. This time I only needed to check how it shows things, rather than report a fault. When I'm done getting ready, I'll leave it as it is without hanging anything on it.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-18-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say this was a check of the view rather than a fault and that you will not hang anything on it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-18-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-18-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご確認ありがとうございました。それでは、ごゆっくりお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-18-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for checking. Please enjoy your time here.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-19-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-19-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お飲み物の追加でしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-023-19-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-19-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: いいえ、この新聞を読んでいる途中です。手を洗いに行く間、新聞を自分の席に置いておいても大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-19-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 手洗中に読途中新聞を席へ置けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-19-001-SHARED-02.translation: No, I'm partway through reading this newspaper. May I leave it at my seat while I go and wash my hands?
DLG-SC-LOC-023-19-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may leave the unfinished newspaper at your seat while washing your hands. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-19-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-19-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 短い間でしたら、そのまま置いて構いません。貴重品はお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-19-001-SHARED-03.translation: For a short time, you can leave it there. Please take your valuables with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-19-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-19-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 財布と携帯は持って行きます。新聞の上に財布を置いて席を取るつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-19-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 財布携帯を携行し置いて席を取らないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-19-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll take my wallet and phone. I won't leave my wallet on the newspaper to reserve the seat.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-19-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will take your wallet and phone and will not leave them to reserve the seat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-19-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-19-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 戻られたら、続けてお読みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-19-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can continue reading when you return.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-19-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-19-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。新聞を持って洗面所へ行くと、ぬらしてしまいそうなので席に残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-19-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 新聞をぬらさず席へ残す理由を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-19-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I'm leaving the newspaper at my seat because I might get it wet if I take it to the washroom.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-19-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain why you are leaving the newspaper at the seat to avoid getting it wet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-19-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-19-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 飲み物に触れない所へ置いてくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-19-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please put it somewhere it won't touch your drink.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-19-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-19-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: カップから離して、折り目に沿って畳みます。記事の途中に印を付けたいですが、店の新聞には書かないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-19-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: カップから離し畳み店新聞に書かないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-19-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll keep it away from the cup and fold it along its creases. I'd like to mark where I stopped in the article, but I won't write on the shop's newspaper.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-19-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will fold it away from the cup and will not write on the shop's newspaper. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-19-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-19-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 必要なら、記事のページを覚えておくとよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-19-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you need to, you could remember the page the article is on.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-19-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-19-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 七ページを覚えておきます。戻ってから続きを読むので、今はほかの人へ回さず少し置かせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-19-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 七ページを覚え戻って読むまで保持を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-19-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll remember page seven. Since I'll continue reading when I return, please let me leave it for a moment without passing it to someone else yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-19-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Remember page seven and ask to keep the newspaper until you return to continue reading. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-19-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-19-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、お戻りをお待ちしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-19-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll see you when you return.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-20-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-20-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 荷の移動を始める前に、何か確認はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-20-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything to check before starting to move the load?

DLG-SC-LOC-023-20-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-20-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。向こうの二人が同時に手を上げています。どちらの合図に従えばいいか分からないので、まだ動かしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-20-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人の同時合図で未操作と報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-20-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Those two people are raising their hands at the same time. I don't know whose signal to follow, so I haven't moved it yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-20-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that you have not operated the equipment because two people are signaling at once. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-20-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-20-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 動かさずに待ってください。今日の合図担当をこちらで確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-20-001-SHARED-03.translation: Wait without moving it. We'll check who is in charge of signaling today.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-20-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-20-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 待ちます。私は荷のそばの立入禁止の線より外にいます。自分の判断で片方を選ばないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-20-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 安全線外で待ち自己選択しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-20-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll wait. I'm outside the restricted-area line beside the load. I won't choose one of them on my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-20-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will wait outside the safety line and will not choose a signaler yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-20-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-20-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認しました。赤い腕章の佐藤さんが合図担当です。もう一人の方には合図を止めてもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-20-001-SHARED-05.translation: We've checked. Mr. Sato with the red armband is the designated signaler. We'll have the other person stop signaling.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-20-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-20-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 赤い腕章の佐藤さんですね。ただ、今の位置からは腕章が荷に隠れます。見える位置と連絡方法を決めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-20-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 指定担当を復唱し視認性と連絡方法の調整を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-20-001-SHARED-06.translation: Mr. Sato with the red armband, understood. But from my current position, the load hides his armband. Please decide a position where I can see him and how we should communicate.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-20-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Repeat the designated signaler and ask to adjust visibility and the communication method. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-20-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-20-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現場の手順に沿って配置を調整します。調整が終わるまで作業は止めておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-20-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll adjust the positions according to site procedures. Work will remain stopped until the adjustment is complete.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-20-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-20-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 了解しました。移動先を勝手に変えず、指示を待ちます。担当が見えなくなった場合の止め方も、再開前に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-20-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 配置指示を待ち見失時停止手順も確認希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-20-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I won't change where I'm going on my own; I'll wait for instructions. Before restarting, I also want to check how to stop if I lose sight of the signaler.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-20-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will wait for positioning instructions and want to check the stopping procedure if you lose sight of the signaler. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-20-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-20-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 再開前の打ち合わせで、その手順を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-20-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's check that procedure at the meeting before restarting.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-20-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-20-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二人の合図が重なったことと腕章が見えないことを伝えます。担当と停止手順がはっきりしてから作業を再開します。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-20-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 重複合図と視認問題を報告し手順確定後再開する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-20-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll report that the two signals overlapped and I can't see the armband. I'll restart work only after the designated signaler and stopping procedure are clear.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-20-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report the overlapping signals and visibility problem, and restart after procedures are settled. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-20-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-20-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その確認をしてから再開しましょう。それでは、打ち合わせ場所へどうぞ。お疲れさまです。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-20-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's restart after checking those points. Please go to the meeting place. Thank you for your work.
